clips.title: The story
paras: Having done a service for the gnomes, Kravel Koalbeard now wants to do the goblins a favor. He has heard that Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once went by another name, and wonders whether it is a secret worth money. He sends you to Krazek of Booty Bay, who would know.

Kravel Koalbeard says the goblins are next in line for a favor. Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once went by another name, he hears, and Kravel wonders why it changed, whether it hides a secret, and whether Nazz cares to keep it hidden. The one who would know the truth, Kravel says, is Krazek, down at the southern tip of Stranglethorn in Booty Bay. Useful information might turn a profit. Look for Krazek at the Salty Sailor Tavern.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that we've done a service for the gnomes, it's time to do the goblins a favor!
I hear that the goblin racer pilot, Nazz Steamboil, didn't always use that name. I wonder why he changed it. I wonder if it's a secret, and... I wonder if he values that secret.
If anyone knows the truth, then it's Krazek of Booty Bay, on the southern tip of Stranglethorn. Speak with Krazek and ask him about our goblin pilot.
If you can get useful information from him, then we might just turn a profit from it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You want to know about Nazz Steamboil? He's a racer pilot out in the Shimmering Flats, isn't he?
Yeah, I might be able to find something out about him... But it won't be easy. Or fast.
